The graph version exists: Cassi (1992), after Hattori, Hattori and Watanabe (1987), proves that spectral dimension at most 2 excludes spontaneous magnetization for O(n) and Heisenberg models (as Gelfert and Nolting report it), and Nachtergaele's proof needs no translation invariance.
